expectedIssues: Orders icon is missing from the bottom nav bar
reportedIssues: The last restaurant in the 'Fastest near you' row (Trattoria Piccol) is clipped at the right edge, cutting off both the image and the restaurant name.
The category filter chips overflow the right edge; 'Healthy' is cut off and the next chip is only a sliver.
The Orders tab in the bottom navigation has a label but no icon, unlike Home, Search, and Profile.
The second Popular card (pizza with -20%) is cut off by the bottom tab bar, so the restaurant name, rating, and other details are not visible.
The notification bell badge sits very close to the status-bar battery area and may feel cramped on notched devices.
Delivery-time pills on the first-row cards sit over the food images and can obscure the dish illustration.

expected.reasoning: Issue 2 describes the Orders tab in bottom navigation missing its icon, which matches the expected defect of the Orders icon being missing from the bottom nav bar.
